title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — November 24, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B1.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B2.6 (Peaked November 24, 2026 at 00:41 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 328 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.00)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

A broad coronal-hole region is the standout feature in today’s solar images, while sunspot activity remains limited.

Images: NASA SDO/AIA — 193, 335, 171, 304, 131, 94 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
